name: chen-sheng-wu-guang-revolt
friendly_name: Chen Sheng and Wu Guang Revolt
description: Conscripts delayed by floods and facing execution rose against China's harsh first imperial dynasty, sparking a mass revolt.

name: boudica-revolt
description: A widowed Iceni queen rallied British tribes and burned Roman Colchester, London and St Albans before being crushed.

name: zanj-rebellion-begins
description: Enslaved East Africans draining salt marshes in Iraq rose against the caliphate and held out for well over a decade.

name: pilgrimage-of-grace-rising
description: Tens of thousands in northern England rose to protest the closing of monasteries and the religious policies of Henry VIII.

name: pueblo-revolt-spanish-expelled
description: Pueblo peoples of the Southwest united to drive Spanish settlers and missionaries from their homeland for a dozen years.

name: pugachev-rebellion
description: A Cossack claiming to be the murdered tsar raised serfs and Cossacks and threatened Catherine the Great's throne.

name: tupac-amaru-ii-rebellion
description: A descendant of Inca royalty led Andean Indigenous and mixed-race people against Spanish taxes and forced labour.

name: zapatista-uprising-chiapas
description: Masked Indigenous rebels seized towns in Chiapas on the day a major trade pact took effect, demanding land and rights.
